title: Switching Frictions, Heterogeneous Trading Horizons, and Long-Memory Order Flow
abstract: arXiv:2609.02525v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a mechanism through which costly changes in the representations used for portfolio choice can contribute to persistent signed order flow. Heterogeneous switching thresholds and opportunity volatility generate heterogeneous residence times, and renewal aggregation maps their execution-weighted tail into the decay of aggregate flow covariance. Under common execution weights, the same tail determines the exponent of representation-spell durations, the order-flow memory exponent, and the horizon at which finite-market scaling must end. First-passage renewal analysis establishes these joint restrictions. Structural simulations recover them from realized paths, quantify the distortion created by mismatched weights, and show how finite cross sections shorten the usable inference horizon. translated_title: 切换摩擦、异质交易视界与长记忆订单流
translated_abstract: 本文构建了一个机制，用以说明投资组合决策中所使用“表示”的代价高昂的切换如何促成持续的带符号订单流。异质的切换阈值与机会波动率产生异质的停留时间，而更新聚合将其执行加权后的分布尾部映射为总体订单流协方差的衰减。在共同执行权重下，同一条尾部同时决定了表示持续期的指数、订单流记忆指数，以及有限市场标度必须终止的视界。首达时间更新分析确立了这些联合约束。结构化模拟从实现路径中恢复了这些约束，量化了权重不匹配所造成的扭曲，并展示了有限截面如何缩短可用的推断视界。由此得到的实证协议将总体持续性拟合转化为跨数据集约束，可用于判断持续期……
tldr: 本文提出：投资组合决策中付出代价的“表示切换”摩擦经更新聚合后，其执行加权尾部可同时决定表示持续期指数、订单流长记忆指数与有限市场标度的截止视界，从而为持续带符号订单流提供可跨数据集检验的统一联合约束。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that costly switching frictions in portfolio-choice representations, aggregated through a renewal framework, jointly determine representation-duration tail exponents, order-flow memory exponents, and finite-market scaling horizons, yielding cross-dataset restrictions that explain persistent signed order flow.
